_context_dependence_warning: CONTEXT-DEPENDENT ON TWO SEPARATE AXES, and conflating them is how this file misled an editor once already (corrected in techne#591; ONLY this prose key changed — no measured value was touched, and the file's indentation is untouched too). Everything here was measured in ONE context: a NON-FORK pull_request on tenishai/techne (see _context). BY FORK-NESS, exactly TWO rows invert on a fork PR: 'head.repo.fork == false' and the NEW_GUARD keyed with full_name — and that inversion is the feature, not a discrepancy. FORK_ONLY does NOT invert by fork-ness, despite reading like it should: '<absent> != github.repository' is 'null != tenishai/techne', true in every context, because the property is ABSENT from the payload rather than holding a fork's name. BY EVENT, the three rows carrying event_name diverge under `push`: NEW-with-<absent> goes false->TRUE, FORK_ONLY goes true->FALSE, and OLD stays true because its negation absorbs the change — which is precisely why the OLD guard failed open regardless of event.
_never_measured: NO ROW HERE COVERS A FORK PR ACTUALLY FIRING `fork-pr`. No fork of this repo exists, so the fork-side behaviour of the trust split is a HAND TRACE. One fork PR from a personal account would convert it to measured.
